files.mirrors: X1 spec §6 060100 (X1-01: reference data, positions, position manning), 060200 (X1-02: vessel crew list, movements, transfers table), 060300 (X1-03: personal details, languages, employment terms, next-of-kin phone columns, profile RPCs), 060400 (X1-04: document catalogue, vessel crew settings, crew document columns, document RPCs), 060500 (X1-05: document versions, review rights, verify, alerts off and on, renew) and 060600 (X1-06: requirement rows, options and positions, the compliance views, the compliance and configuration RPCs)

X1 spec §6 060700 (X1-07: the hours-of-rest engine: vessel settings margins, serious thresholds, HoD step and reminders, month signer columns, breach day, serious flag, deficit and review columns, stale signatures, and the save, fill and month RPCs) and 060800 (X1-08: the reminder log, the breach reports, the breach review view for fleet operations R9, and the board, month statistics, breach list, review, reminder and breach report RPCs)

functions.crew_vessel_cap: RLS predicate and X1 definer gate (X1 spec §3, 20261124060100): text-first boolean the policies and every X1 definer call; the client gates with useCan() on the same capability keys
functions.crew_cap_vessel_ids: RLS helper (D-229, X1 spec §3, 20261124060100): the caller's vessels holding a capability key, computed once per statement in the X1 read policies; the browser does not call it
functions.crew_caller_is_external: RLS and RPC helper (D-229, X1 spec §3, 20261124060200): caller-only boolean the crew_movements / crew_transfers policies and the crew RPCs use to refuse external viewers; the browser does not call it
functions.crew_profile_visible: RLS and X1 definer helper (X1 spec §3, 20261124060300): one-argument boolean "the caller may see this person" the profile definers gate with; the page asks crew_profile_resolve / crew_profile_summary, which answer P0002 for an invisible person
functions.crew_visible_profile_ids: RLS helper (D-229, X1 spec §3, 20261124060300): the profiles the caller may see, computed once per statement in the crew_personal_details / crew_languages read policies; the browser does not call it
functions.crew_document_visible_profile_ids: RLS helper (D-229, X1 spec §3, 20261124060400): the profiles whose documents the caller may read, computed once per statement in the crew_certificates read policy; the browser does not call it
functions.crew_requirement_status_rows: Gated SRF (X1-06, 20261124060600; contract 5): the requirement status rows of the caller's crew_compliance.view vessels, read through the security-invoker view crew_requirement_status (declared in CrewPendingViews); the browser does not call it directly
functions.crew_compliance_summary_rows: Gated SRF (X1-06, 20261124060600; contract 5): the compliance summaries of the caller's crew_compliance.view vessels, read through the security-invoker view crew_compliance_summary (declared in CrewPendingViews); the browser does not call it directly

tables.crew_document_type_legacy_map: Service-only mapping (20261124060400): legacy certificate strings to document types, read by the backfill and crew_certificates_guard; no browser grant
tables.crew_document_expiry_notices: Service-only bookkeeping (20261124060500): which recipient was told about which crew document at which expiry stage, written by crew_document_expiry_sweep; no browser grant

views.expiry_src_crew_documents: X5 expiry source view (D-X5-01 contract, 20261124060400): read only by X5's definers (fleet_expiry_rows_for); no browser grant
views.crew_requirement_status_internal: Internal engine view (X1-06, 20261124060600): crew_requirement_status_for() over every vessel (security invoker); service role only (REVOKEd from PUBLIC, anon and authenticated); its row type is the return type of crew_vessel_requirement_status (CrewRequirementStatusDbRow)
views.crew_compliance_summary_internal: Internal engine view (X1-06, 20261124060600): crew_compliance_summary_for() over every vessel (security invoker); service role only; its row type is the return type of crew_vessel_compliance and crew_compliance_for_vessels (CrewComplianceSummaryDbRow)
